skills.name: Flamed Shadow (炎影)
skills.description: Hakuzousu attacks a single target dealing damage equal to 100% of his ATK and has a 100% base chance of inflict them with Burnt Flame, lasts for 1 turn. ;Burnt Flame (残炎) : :'''Debuff, Status''': ATK is decreased by 10%.

skills.name: Sheltering Pact (約束を守る)
skills.description:
Exclusive effect.
At the end of Hakuzosu's turn, grants Fox Shadow: Shelter to all allies, lasts until the start of his next turn. ;Fox Shadow：Shelter (狐影・守) : :'''Buff, Mark''': When receiving damage, absorbs 20% of that damage up to a max of 10% of his max HP. :''(Only Hakuzousu gains the effect icon, all other allies will have a small fox mark circle around them.)''

upgrades.text: '''Fox Shadow: Shelter''': Damage absorption increases to 30%.

When Fox Shadow: Shelter is broken, and if Hakuzousu isn't inflicted with any control effects, he launches a counter-attack against the source of the damage, dealing damage equal to 10% of his max HP and has a 100% base chance to inflict decreases their Crit by 30% (effect cannot be stacked). This damage is increased when multiple are broken at the same time.
'''Fox Shadow: Shelter''': Damage absorption increases to 40%.
His SPD and RES are permanently increased by 60 and 60%, respectively. Each ally with Fox Shadow: Shelter decreases his SPD by 10 and RES by 10%.

skills.name: Shadowing Shelter (夢山狐影)
skills.line: As long as I'm here, you'll be just fine!
skills.description: Hakuzosu creates a Fox Shadow realm, lasts for 1 turn. Whenever an ally receives single-target damage or indirect damage, the damage is reduced by 35%. ; : :
